assets.rightsBasis: Official Anna University emblem and wordmark served from the university's own domain and used in its site header. No open licence; used only to identify the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/png, 112,002 bytes, 631x78 px, RGBA. Rendered on white and visually confirmed legible: the circular emblem ('Anna University', 'Progress through knowledge') beside 'Anna University, Chennai' in Tamil and English in dark blue. It is a wide lock-up (about 8:1); for a square tile, crop to the emblem on the left or pad with white.

Official homepage slider photograph on the university's own domain. No open licence; used only to depict the institution. Checked 2026-10-23: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, 148,663 bytes, 1280x548 px (landscape). Visually confirmed as a single real aerial photograph, not a composite or AI image: the red-brick, domed main building of the College of Engineering Guindy surrounded by trees, with the front lawn and road; no text overlay; no identifiable people. Rejected: images/ceg_campus.jpeg (350x250 px, too small).
